title: HDH: A Python Library for Hypergraph-Based Distributed Quantum Computing Partitioning
description: HDH (Hybrid Dependency Hypergraphs) is a Python library that converts a quantum computation, expressed as a circuit, a measurement-based pattern, a quantum walk or a quantum cellular automaton, into a hypergraph that captures every way the computation could be split across devices, and provides a capacity-aware partitioning baseline.
